rule: Only sources with licence_confirmed=true may be used on screen. Every on-screen number must trace to one of these.

spc_tornadoes.title: NOAA/NWS Storm Prediction Center Severe Weather Database - tornadoes 1950-2025
spc_tornadoes.publisher: NOAA National Weather Service, Storm Prediction Center
spc_tornadoes.licence: Public domain: NWS web pages and data are in the public domain unless noted (weather.gov/disclaimer)
spc_tornadoes.checked_facts: 73,458 tornado records 1950-2025; 596 rated F4/EF4, 60 rated F5/EF5

spc_hail_wind.title: SPC Severe Weather Database - hail and damaging wind 1955-2024

hurdat2.title: Atlantic hurricane database HURDAT2 1851-2025 (and NE/Central Pacific 1949-2025)

gridsat_b1.title: NOAA CDR GridSat-B1 11-micron brightness temperature (real satellite cloud images, 1980-present, 3-hourly)
gridsat_b1.publisher: NOAA NCEI CDR Program (Knapp et al. 2011, doi 10.7289/V59P2ZKR)
gridsat_b1.licence: CDR Use Agreement: non-proprietary, no restrictions placed upon their use; citation requested

nasa_gibs.title: NASA GIBS / Worldview satellite imagery (MODIS, VIIRS true colour, 2000-present)
nasa_gibs.licence: NASA: data openly available without restriction; credit NASA Worldview

usgs_comcat.title: USGS ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat)
usgs_comcat.licence: USGS-authored data are U.S. public domain; credit requested (usgs.gov copyrights-and-credits)
usgs_comcat.checked_facts: M4+ California box since 1900: 4,362; M5+ Alaska box: 3,376; M5+ lower 48: 1,323; M3+ Oklahoma box: 3,087 (counts on 2026-11-22)

usgs_3dep.title: USGS 3D Elevation Program (relief for 3D scenes)
usgs_3dep.data: elevation.nationalmap.gov 3DEPElevation ImageServer (hillshade + elevation for storm surge)

etopo.title: NOAA ETOPO1 / ETOPO 2022 global relief (land + sea floor)
etopo.licence: NOAA data, open; no copyright statement found - treated as US Government work (to re-check before production)

ncei_hazards.title: NCEI Global Historical Tsunami, Significant Earthquake and Significant Volcanic Eruption databases
ncei_hazards.licence: No licence statement on page; US Government work - confirm before build
ncei_hazards.checked_facts: 277 tsunami events with country USA since 1800; 50 significant eruptions United States

storm_events.title: NOAA NCEI Storm Events Database 1950-2025 (floods, blizzards, heat, wind, hail, surge)

nifc_perimeters.title: NIFC InterAgency Fire Perimeter History - all years
nifc_perimeters.licence: Federal interagency data; nifc.gov disclaimer page 404 - confirm on the dataset page before build

mtbs.title: Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (burned area boundaries 1984-2024)
mtbs.licence: USGS/USFS federal data; confirm citation page before build

jpl_fireballs.title: CNEOS Fireball and Bolide data (US Government sensors, 1988-present)
jpl_fireballs.licence: No licence statement; NASA data - confirm
jpl_fireballs.checked_facts: 888 fireballs worldwide with location, 31 over the lower 48

viirs_night_lights.title: NASA Black Marble night lights (city lights effect)
viirs_night_lights.licence: NASA imagery, openly available; confirm per product

excluded.openfema: Terms limit use to statistical research or reporting + mandatory disclaimer - not used on screen
excluded.us_drought_monitor: (c) National Drought Mitigation Center, permission page not confirmed - not used
excluded.billion_dollar_disasters: NCEI page gives a 2025 citation; check whether it is still updated before any topic

event_names.rule: Place name of every famous tornado card checked on an NWS page (2026-11-22). Numbers on the card come from the SPC database row.
event_names.jackson: weather.gov/jan/19660303_tornado (Candlestick Park tornado, south Jackson MS)
event_names.joplin: weather.gov/news/052212-joplin + NWS Central Region service assessment (Joplin EF5)
event_names.ruskin: weather.gov/eax/RuskinHeights (Ruskin Heights F5, May 20, 1957; began near Williamsburg KS). Replaced Udall 1955: NWS confirms Udall, but the SPC straight path line passes 25 km from the town, so the close-up would be wrong.

blue_marble.title: Blue Marble Next Generation (GIBS layer BlueMarble_NextGeneration)
blue_marble.publisher: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA EOSDIS GIBS
blue_marble.licence: NASA imagery, openly available without restriction; credit NASA

black_marble.title: Black Marble night lights 2016 (GIBS layer VIIRS_Black_Marble)
black_marble.licence: NASA imagery, openly available without restriction; credit NASA
black_marble.note: not used since the miniature-world style (23.11)

usgs_naip.title: USGS The National Map orthoimagery (USGSImageryOnly, NAIP)
usgs_naip.licence: US Government work, public domain; credit USGS The National Map
usgs_naip.note: not used since the miniature-world style (23.11)

osm_buildings.title: OpenStreetMap: buildings, streets, land use, water, place names
osm_buildings.licence: ODbL 1.0 - attribution required: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (in every description)

nlcd.title: National Land Cover Database 2021 (land cover classes for the stylized map)
nlcd.licence: USGS public domain; no restrictions (mrlc.gov data are public domain)
nlcd.note: fetched on the owner's PC (the MRLC server refuses GitHub runner addresses)

surge_visual.title: Storm-surge flooding in the hurricane close-ups (picture only, no number on screen)
surge_visual.publisher: NOAA NHC Tropical Cyclone Reports (nhc.noaa.gov/data/tcr) and NWS event pages
surge_visual.rule: flood level in metres over USGS 3DEP ground, kept below the reported peak storm tide; illustrative, never labelled as a measurement
surge_visual.todo: record the TCR peak value per storm before publishing the hurricane film
